regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours - your dear Parents especially and His mercy and your dear old Grandma and her good Husband. Sorry I could not have seen her before she became childish. Now all we can do for them is to remember them in our prayer and Masses. I am glad to hear from yourself - that you are still with us. I think it was when you were three the doctors would not have bet much on your living. Well, thank God for Everything .. . Very best regards and wishes to your dear Parents. I used to quite enjoy my visits over there to the West Side twenty years back. Thanks be to God, my health has been good ever since I went West for a vacation to the First Mass of my nephew in Seattle, Wash'n. It is much easier here though it is not a small job to keep the letters from accumu- lating. I am inscribing your name in my emergency list for your speedy im- provement and recovery - please God.
